hostname ix-p01
!
ip route default 203.0.113.14
ip route 198.51.100.128/25 Tunnel0.0
!
ikev2 authentication psk id ipv4 203.0.113.9 key char dummy-psk-sample-b
ikev2 authentication psk id ipv4 203.0.113.30 key char dummy-psk-sample-b
!
ip access-list sec-p1 10 permit ip src 192.0.2.0/25 dest 198.51.100.0/25
ip access-list sec-p1 20 permit ip src 192.0.2.0/25 dest 198.51.100.200/32
ike proposal ike-prop-p1 encryption aes-256 hash sha2-256 group 2048-bit lifetime 86400
ike proposal ike-prop-p1-2 encryption aes hash sha group 1024-bit
ike policy ike-p1 peer 203.0.113.20 key dummy-psk-sample-a ike-prop-p1,ike-prop-p1-2
ipsec autokey-proposal ipsec-prop-p1 esp-aes-256 esp-sha lifetime time 3600
ipsec autokey-proposal ipsec-prop-p1-2 esp-aes esp-sha
ipsec autokey-map CMAP-SAMPLE-10 sec-p1 peer 203.0.113.20 pfs 2048-bit ipsec-prop-p1,ipsec-prop-p1-2
!
ikev2 profile ikev2-0
  child-lifetime 3600
  child-pfs off
  child-proposal enc aes-cbc-256 aes-cbc-128
  child-proposal integrity sha1
  local-authentication psk
  local-ts ipv4 address 192.0.2.0/25
  nat-traversal
  remote-ts ipv4 address 198.51.100.128/25
  sa-lifetime 86400
  sa-proposal dh 2048-bit 1536-bit
  sa-proposal enc aes-cbc-256 aes-cbc-128
  sa-proposal integrity sha2-256 sha1
!
ike nat-traversal
!
interface GigaEthernet0.0
  description sample-wan
  ip address 203.0.113.9/29
  ipsec policy tunnel CMAP-SAMPLE-10 out
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet1.0
  description sample-lan
  ip address 192.0.2.1/25
  no shutdown
!
interface Tunnel0.0
  ip address 198.51.100.249/30
  tunnel mode ipsec-ikev2
  ikev2 binding ikev2-0
  ikev2 peer 203.0.113.30 authentication psk
  ikev2 source-address GigaEthernet0.0
  no shutdown
!
